label: thm.ideal.generators
title: Explicit minimal generators for the rational-function-evaluation vanishing ideal
difficulty_reason: The proof constructs a determinantal generating family and reduces arbitrary polynomials to a fixed-core normal form without assuming the target ideal characterization. The nonroutine remaining obligation is to prove that every nonzero cored remainder is hit, using the authors’ full Zoom Lemma and its extremal degree-pattern construction in Sections3–4; this goes beyond ordinary qualification-level ideal computations.
review_note: Full original Sections1–9 and bibliography are retained. Selected Theorem1.3 includes both the complete generating family and minimum-size fixed-core family. Section3 supplies determinant construction, cored reduction and final proof; Section4 supplies the full Zoom Lemma and the proof of the cored hitting claim. All source-local core is editable and retained. No independent mathematical refereeing or proof repair.
cluster_note: 645 is the general generating-set outcome. 646 is Theorem1.8 multilinear membership; 647 is Theorem1.9 ROABP hitting, with a separate coefficient-matrix rank core. Only unqueued Theorem1.10 is the equivalent complementary ROABP formulation, and remains uncounted support. 648 concerns a separate set-multilinear span characterization with its own ESMVC construction; no supporting lemmas are separately counted.
